scope: Hungarian keyword opportunity mapping for panellako.hu — full-funnel, all 8 topic clusters
summary:
Agent 02 completed full keyword opportunity mapping across 8 topic clusters and 3 funnel stages for panellako.hu. 28 cluster-level keyword groups identified. Hungarian-language SERPs for HOA management software remain remarkably under-developed: the primary conversion cluster ('társasházi kezelő szoftver') has a competition score of 2/10 and zero dedicated SaaS comparison pages in organic results. The TOFU environmental-data clusters (levegőminőség, hőszigetek, zajszennyezés, 15 perces város) have near-zero competition from any publisher — panellako.hu is uniquely positioned to own all of these as the only platform combining urban data with building management. Competitor landscape confirmed: eHÁZ (~13,000 buildings, zero blog/SEO), OnlineHáz (1-year free, SEO-light), WHM Cloud (minor blog), Netház (25+ years, desktop-first), tarsashaziszoftver.hu (aggregator directory). None of them target environmental or urban data keywords, none have English-comparable topical authority structures. Panellakás price acceleration (panellakás ár Budapest +36% YoY, peak ~80M HUF for renovated XIII kerület) is generating new urgent buyer/owner search intent that panellako.hu can capture via informational content about building management quality indicators tied to neighborhood data.

Keyword gap analysis — top 5 missing topic areas:
1. COMPETITOR COMPARISON PAGES: No page targets 'PanelLakó vs eHÁZ', 'PanelLakó vs OnlineHáz', or 'legjobb társasházi szoftver' directly. The /osszehasonlitas page exists but only compares vs Excel/WhatsApp — missing the software-vs-software angle that decision-makers search.
2. PRICING INTENT KEYWORDS: The /arak page exists but targets no long-tail pricing queries like 'közös képviselő szoftver ár havi díj', 'ingyenes társasházi program', 'albetét ár szoftver'. These are high-conversion BOFU terms with minimal competition.
3. LOCAL SEO / CITY-SPECIFIC LANDING PAGES: No city-specific pages exist (e.g., 'társasházi szoftver Debrecen', 'közös képviselő program Győr'). With 23 Budapest districts + major cities, this is a large untapped programmatic or pillar opportunity.
4. ACCOUNTANT / KÖNYVELŐ PERSONA: Zero pages target the accountant decision-maker persona searching 'társasházi könyvelő szoftver', 'közös képviselő könyvelés digitalizálás', 'kettős könyvelés társasház program'. This persona is a multiplier — one accountant handles 10-50 buildings.
5. LIFECYCLE / CASE STUDY CONTENT: No use-case, case study, or success-story content exists targeting 'hogyan kezeli a közös képviselő a hátralékot digitálisan', 'online közgyűlés tapasztalatok', 'társasházi szoftver bevezetése'. This is the MOFU bridge content that converts TOFU readers into trial signups.

keyword_gap_analysis.summary: Five major topic areas are missing from panellako.hu's current content architecture. These gaps collectively represent the highest-conversion and lowest-competition opportunities available to the domain.

gaps.description: The /osszehasonlitas page compares PanelLakó to Excel/WhatsApp. No page compares it to eHÁZ, OnlineHáz, WHM Cloud, or Netház — the actual alternatives a buyer evaluates. Search queries like 'PanelLakó vs eHÁZ' and 'legjobb társasházi szoftver 2026' are unaddressed.

Zero pages target the accountant who manages 10–50 buildings. This persona is the highest-leverage multiplier for B2B customer acquisition. Competitors (WHM Cloud, szoftver.tarsashazaink.hu) actively target this segment.

gaps.description: No dedicated conversion-optimized landing page exists for the query 'ingyenes társasházi szoftver' or '14 napos próba'. These transactional queries are the lowest-funnel SEO opportunity on the site.
